reason: B provides the more coherent cross-temperature mechanism: dispersed Ag can lower interfacial shear at low temperature and thermally migrate into a replenishing tribolayer at high temperature, with quantitative predictions and a falsifiable baseline comparison. A largely repeats the cited 0.5 at.% W result from AlCoCrFeNi at 800 °C, while its unsupported oxide-glaze claim and unchanged low-temperature matrix do not convincingly explain reduced friction across the full range.
